name: diffgate
description: A deterministic guardrail your coding agent runs on itself — structured findings on just the changed lines, before the code reaches disk. Zero LLM tokens, 0 false blocks.
long_description: Coding agents don't write textbook vulnerabilities — they delete guardrails while editing (measured: 0% OWASP bugs greenfield, 13% footguns reintroduced on edits). DiffGate is the deterministic tripwire for that residue: it grades each changed line green/yellow/orange by impact in milliseconds, with 0 false blocks. Runs as a CLI, VS Code extension, and this MCP server — the same engine, same rules, everywhere.

tools.name: diffgate_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a file for code review findings. Only flags risk on lines changed vs the git baseline (diff-aware). Pass content to analyze unsaved or generated code before it is written to disk.

tools.name: diffgate_check_staged
tools.description: Check all staged (or working-tree) changes in a git repo for DiffGate findings. Returns overall tier, counts, per-file findings, and an agent autonomy verdict (pass/review/blocked with a rung per finding).

tools.name: diffgate_deep_review
tools.description: Run an agentic deep review on a single high-impact (orange) finding, using real repo tools (grep, read_file, find_references, git_blame) to investigate blast radius before rendering a verdict.

tools.name: diffgate_explain
tools.description: Get a concise AI explanation for a DiffGate finding — a single LLM call, faster than diffgate_deep_review.

tools.name: diffgate_capabilities
tools.description: Report which DiffGate layers are active (core / code graph / LLM), which tools are callable right now, and the agent autonomy budget.

tools.name: diffgate_guidelines
tools.description: Review the diff against the repo's own coding guideline files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, etc.), scoped per directory.

tools.name: diffgate_feedback
tools.description: Record a reviewer's verdict on a finding so DiffGate learns — dismiss suppresses noise, confirm marks a real catch. Stored in .diffgate/learnings.json.
